==Instructions==
This template is to be used for [[StarWars.com]] content published, or still available, after the official site's [https://web.archive.org/web/20120103174843/http://www.starwars.com/news/newstarwarscom.html revamp] on [[September 13]], [[2011]] or after the revamp of early [[2014]]. Content from before this period is identifiable either by the use of .html in filename (<nowiki>http://www.starwars.com/patch/filename.html</nowiki>) or by the complete removal of a selection of the website sections (and url paths) by early 2014 (ex: Shop).

{{SW|url=news/star-wars-valentines-day-gift-guide|text=''Star Wars'' Valentine's Day Gift Guide 2024|oldversion=20240515050634}}

For content published prior to the 2011 and 2014 revamps and not available anymore at any time after the 2014 revamp, use {{Tl|SWArchive}}.

For the original, pre-revamp [[Databank (original)|Databank]], use {{Tl|DB}}.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{SW|subdomain=|url=|text=|int=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>https://www.starwars.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below. Note: the default values for dates are centralized at [[Module:ArchiveAccess/SW]]. This template will use the default value when omitting <code>archivedate</code> or <code>archiveurl</code>, but either can be provided to override the default value.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} The subdomain part of the URL between <code><nowiki>https://</nowiki></code> and <code><nowiki>.starwars.com/</nowiki></code> if its not <code><nowiki>www</nowiki></code>. Default is <code><nowiki>www</nowiki></code> if left blank.
*{{Para|int}} This field provides a link to the [[Wookieepedia]] article, if one exists.
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".
*{{Para|quote}} Relevant quote from the StarWars.com page. Double-quotes will be added automatically.
*{{Para|oldversion}} Set to 1 when the information is not present on the current version of the webpage, necessitating a custom archivedate.

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{SW|url=news/star-wars-is-being-kick-started-with-dynamite|text=Star Wars Is Being Kick-Started with Dynamite|date=2013-01-25}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{SW|url=news/star-wars-is-being-kick-started-with-dynamite|text=Star Wars Is Being Kick-Started with Dynamite|date=2013-01-25}}

<hr />
;int and nolive=1:

<code><nowiki>{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|date=2012-10-25|nolive=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|date=2012-10-25|nolive=1}}

<hr />
;subdomain:

<code><nowiki>{{SW|subdomain=shop|url=catalog/product.xml?topcatID=1300264;product_id=1314666;category_id=1300760|text=The Clone Wars Action Figure Case Pack 2009 Wave 7|nobackup=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{SW|subdomain=shop|url=catalog/product.xml?topcatID=1300264;product_id=1314666;category_id=1300760|text=The Clone Wars Action Figure Case Pack 2009 Wave 7|nobackup=1}}
